tokens.name: bt-main
tokens.usage: The page ground: cream by day, plum at night. Text on it is bt-ink. The logo with ink letters sits on the light value, the logo with cream letters on the dark value.

tokens.name: st-paper
tokens.usage: Paper: cards, menus, sheets, form fields, the secondary button. Text on it is bt-ink.

tokens.name: st-raised
tokens.usage: A surface one step above the page: the footer, raised bands. Text on it is bt-ink.

tokens.name: st-sunk
tokens.usage: A surface pressed into the page: wells and troughs. Text on it is bt-ink.

tokens.name: bt-sidebar
tokens.usage: The app's sidebar ground. In the theme; the site's pages do not use it.

tokens.name: bt-card
tokens.usage: The app's card ground. In the theme; the site's pages use st-paper.

tokens.name: bt-ink
tokens.usage: All text, and the letters of the logo: ink on light, cream on dark. Also the fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bt-main, st-paper and st-raised: ledes, captions, fine print. It is bt-ink at 72%; the site writes it as a colour mix.

tokens.name: bt-accent
tokens.usage: Links on hover, detail links and small accents. Passes 4.5:1 as text on bt-main and st-paper in both themes.

tokens.name: st-ring
tokens.usage: The focus ring (3px outline) and the eyebrow text. Magenta by day, pink at night.

tokens.name: st-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, dividers, the header's bottom edge. Not for text.

tokens.name: st-line-2
tokens.usage: A stronger hairline: field borders, the secondary button, menus and sheets. Not for text.

tokens.name: bt-hover
tokens.usage: The wash under a hovered row or menu button, on any ground. Not for text.

tokens.name: bt-active
tokens.usage: The wash under a pressed or current item. Not for text.

tokens.name: st-cyan
tokens.usage: The cyan tint: one end of the stage, cyan tiles and tags. Text on it is st-cyan-ink.

tokens.name: st-cyan-ink
tokens.usage: Text on st-cyan.

tokens.name: st-lilac
tokens.usage: The lilac tint: lilac tiles and the "Coming soon" pill. Text on it is st-lilac-ink.

tokens.name: st-lilac-ink
tokens.usage: Text on st-lilac. Also the middle stop of the ink gradient on headline words.

tokens.name: bt-user
tokens.usage: The pink tint: the person's own chat bubble in the app, pink tiles on the site. Text on it is bt-user-ink.

tokens.name: bt-user-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bt-user.

tokens.name: bt-bubble
tokens.usage: A Bot's chat bubble in the app. Text on it is bt-ink. In the theme; the site's pages do not use it.

tokens.name: st-spot
tokens.usage: A soft light spot laid over the stage gradient. Not for text.

tokens.name: st-tag
tokens.usage: The ground of a small tag laid over the stage or over art. Text on it is bt-ink.

tokens.name: st-cast
tokens.usage: The cast shadow under clay art standing on the stage. Not for text.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: A soft glow behind art on the stage. Not for text.

tokens.name: st-ok
tokens.usage: Success text on bt-main and st-paper.

tokens.name: st-okdot
tokens.usage: The success dot. Not for text.

tokens.name: st-bad
tokens.usage: Error text on bt-main and st-paper.

tokens.name: st-warn
tokens.usage: Warning text on bt-main and st-paper.

tokens.name: st-warndot
tokens.usage: The warning dot. Not for text.

tokens.name: st-work
tokens.usage: The "working" dot and progress marks. Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: bt-danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions in the app. Same value as st-bad.

tokens.name: bt-green
tokens.usage: Positive actions in the app. Same value as st-ok.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: The dark band used on both themes: the code strip and plum cards. Text on it is on-plum.

tokens.name: plum-2
tokens.usage: The lighter end of a plum band. Text on it is on-plum.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text on plum and plum-2.

tokens.name: on-plum-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on plum and plum-2.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of a code block. Text on it is on-plum.

tokens.name: triskle-cyan
tokens.usage: The mark's cyan piece. From the logo, not from the site's theme. Only in the mark and in brand art: never text, never a UI colour.

tokens.name: triskle-pink
tokens.usage: The mark's pink piece and the sparkle on the i of the wordmark. From the logo. Never text, never a UI colour.

tokens.name: triskle-violet
tokens.usage: The mark's violet piece. From the logo. Never text, never a UI colour.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The site's short name for the page ground.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The site's short name for paper.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The site's short name for the raised surface.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: The site's short name for text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: The site's short name for the hairline.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: The site's short name for the stronger hairline.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The site's short name for the accent.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The site's short name for the focus ring colour.

fonts.note: The title face. Latin and Latin Extended, the weight axis only. sizeAdjust keeps its lines as long as those of Manrope, the face it replaced, so the site's titles break where they did; its small letters come out 1% lower than Manrope's.
The text face. The site's own file; this folder holds no copy.

weights.name: weight-title
weights.usage: Page and section titles, eyebrows and small capital labels. At this weight Fredoka's stroke is 26.5% of its small letters' height, the same as the logo's letters, so a title and the logo read as one family.

weights.name: weight-strong
weights.usage: Card titles, buttons and links: seven eighths of the title weight.

weights.name: weight-label
weights.usage: Menu items and quiet labels: three quarters of the title weight.

families.head: Fredoka, "DM Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif
families.body: "DM Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: Your agent team, in your chats.
styles.usage: The page title (h1). Fluid on the site: clamp(2.6rem, 1.4rem + 4.2vw, 4.6rem); the size here is its largest.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.sample: Use one, or bring them together.
styles.usage: Section titles (h2). Fluid on the site: clamp(1.85rem, 1.15rem + 2.3vw, 3.05rem); the size here is its largest.

styles.name: label-eyebrow
styles.usage: The eyebrow over a heading. Capitals, in st-ring.

styles.name: label-button
styles.usage: Button text. The small button uses 0.88rem.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: Column heads in the footer and small capital labels, in muted.

styles.name: text-intro
styles.sample: A wish becomes a branch, a test run and a report you approve.
styles.usage: The line under a page title. Fluid on the site: clamp(1.15rem, 1rem + 0.55vw, 1.4rem); the size here is its largest.

styles.name: text-lede
styles.sample: The official logo, for print and press. Use it as it is.
styles.usage: The line under a section title, in muted.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Talk with your Bots, hand work over and review what comes back.

styles.name: text-fine
styles.usage: Fine print and captions, in muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code: the reader's own monospace face, on a bt-hover wash with a st-line border.

tokens.name: max
tokens.usage: The widest the page content gets. The site has no spacing scale: its own spacing tokens are this width and the fluid gutter (see Layout).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The site's card corner: product tiles and large panels.

tokens.name: st-r-stage
tokens.usage: The stage: the large gradient panel that holds art.

tokens.name: st-r-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: st-r-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and small panels. The large button uses the same 14px.

tokens.name: st-r-seg
tokens.usage: Segments and small controls.

tokens.name: st-lift
tokens.usage: A card lifted off the page: hovered tiles, the skip link, floating panels.

tokens.name: st-clay
tokens.usage: The clay press: a soft raised object with a lit top edge. Buttons and chips that should feel like clay.

tokens.name: st-hollow
tokens.usage: A hollow pressed into a surface: wells and inset fields.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: The deep shadow under an app window, a menu or a sheet.

layout.note: The site's fluid layout value. It is not a fixed length, so it sits here and not under Spacing.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The page's side gutter. It is fluid: 20px on a phone, 56px on a wide screen.
